title: Dawnguard
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Dawnguard faction: its soldiers, named members and huskies. Death hounds belong to the vampires and stay under *Vampires*; the armoured trolls are on *Troll* (World Creatures → Monsters). bands-of-power.md puts the Dawnguard in Elite (VI), and archetype-tiers.md §3.1 pins every Dawnguard list to rung 06, raised 25 → 38.
